'''Josh Kennedy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Colorado Springs tournament]] on 9 December 2001 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH mains]], according to Dan H's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3163">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-12-9-01huge-turnout-2-colo-sprgs-cod3163/ 12-9-01huge-turnout-2-colo-sprgs-co], DeckTech (Dan "Gil-galad" H, 12 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-12-9-01huge-turnout-2-colo-sprgs-cod3163/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
